title: Nvidia Said We Couldn't Game On This Crypto Mining Card...
summary: Linus Tech Tips tests a Chinese mining-only Nvidia card, hacked with a modified driver so it can render games and output video through an integrated GPU.
why: HN cites it as precedent for repurposing mining-only GPUs for graphics, in threads about Nvidia limiting mining on gaming cards.

quote.text: I first heard about using the p106-p90 cards on Windows with a modified driver via a LTT video [1].
